text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... my head hurts.
Ever since this morning... even after taking medicine...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Times like this, Mama used to do this for me.
It feels like you'll get better faster..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Hey, will you pat my head? Pleeease—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I'm so bad at acting spoiled...
Ugh, I hate this~~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Vivlos continued to be plagued
by her headache...
